# Timeline

| Day | When | What happens | Who knows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Morning | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] turns ten. Marcos gives him a leather notebook for observations. | Family, Marcos |
| Day 1 | Evening | At supper, [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] asks his father directly about the hill. Father says he is old enough now, but must be home before dark. | Family |
| Day 2 | Morning | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] gathers supplies: smooth stones from the jar, his fossil Captain Crunch, his new notebook. | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO], Bruno |
| Day 2 | Afternoon | Rosa finds him at the village fountain and asks where he is going. He tells her he is going to climb the hill. | Rosa |
| Day 3 | Morning | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] asks Marcos directly about the hill. Marcos says the hill itself will teach him what he needs to know. | Marcos |
| Day 3 | Afternoon | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] and Bruno walk to the foot of the hill and explore the lower path. They climb a little way and turn back before attempting the full crossing. | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO], Bruno |
| Day 4 | Morning | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] and Bruno set out to climb the hill in earnest. The sun is high and they have the whole day ahead. | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO], Bruno |
| Day 4 | Afternoon | They climb past the point where the path becomes unclear, into the stones and shade. Bruno becomes nervous; [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] feels real fear but continues anyway. | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO], Bruno |
| Day 4 | Late Afternoon | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] and Bruno reach the crest of the hill and see Elena's house and the land beyond for the first time. They meet Elena in her yard. | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO], Elena, Bruno |
| Day 4 | Sunset | The sun touches the horizon. [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] realizes he cannot safely descend the hill in darkness. Elena invites him and Bruno to shelter. | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO], Elena |
| Day 5 | Dawn | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] and Elena descend the hill together by early light, Bruno moving between them. They reach the foot of the hill as the sun rises. | Elena, [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] |
| Day 5 | Morning | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] arrives home dirty, tired, and hours after dawn. His family is waiting anxiously. | Family |
| Day 5 | Later | [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] tells his family about Elena, her grandmother, the house, and staying through the night. Marcos listens with a quiet smile that says he already knew. | Family, Marcos |
